subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the N55 across all 7 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The N55 is one of the engines we've worked on extensively — fitted across seven different applications from the M135i to the X5 xDrive35i.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, gaskets, and oil filter housing gasket as standard on every rebuild. Intake valves are inspected and cleaned for carbon buildup where required.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: Carbon buildup on intake valves (direct injection), charge pipe failure, and oil filter housing gasket leaks. We don't treat any of these as a guaranteed failure — diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild or replacement.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed N55 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
